# Project Instructions

- Use React and TypeScript for package code.
- Keep the published component compatible with free `@mui/material` and `@mui/x-date-pickers` packages.
- Preserve adapter-agnostic date handling through MUI's `LocalizationProvider`.
- Keep package code, demo code, and tests separated.
- Run `npm run build`, `npm run test`, and `npm run lint` after implementation changes.
- Do not copy code or assets from MUI X Pro; implement behavior with public free APIs.
